The '''Floor TV''' is a piece of [[furniture]]. It can be purchased at the [[Carpenter's Shop]] for {{Price|700}}.

It's also available from the [[Furniture Catalogue]] for {{Price|0}}. 

Players who select any [[Farm Maps|non-standard farm map]] during character creation will have this TV inside their house when the game begins.

Players can view [[television]] programs by {{key|right-clicking}} on the Floor TV.

==Trivia==
* Despite being labeled as the "budget" option, the [[Budget TV]] actually costs {{Price|50}} more than the Floor TV.
